_comment: Feature-isolated fixture scenes for golden.py --tier fixtures. 'families' expand into one fixture per official asset (effects). Each entry names the official documentation pages it covers (relative to docs/en/); COVERAGE-MATRIX.md is derived from these lists plus the workshop probe report. Optional 'scenario' selects a scenarios/*.json for the fixture.

bone-animation-mask.description: Disabled bone animation tracks preserve earlier poses. Rotation springs follow animation and consume angular impulses without changing the same-frame pose; positive and negative inputs exercise authored angle limits through actual skinned draws.

bone-translation-spring.description: Translation spring: drag a bone, release it, and observe the actual skinned mesh returning to its authored pose. Then apply two directional impulses and observe velocity-driven motion without an immediate pose change. Reset the moving spring without rewriting the current pose or its history.

fbo-dimensions.description: Image/text effect target dimensions: explicit axes, fit cap and truncation, scale division, typed numeric admission and retained relayout sizing.

shared-fbo-dimensions.description: Same-name text FBO acquisition and later setup with overlapping deletion/recreation, a surviving sampler, different requesting divisors and equal physical extents.

destroy-callback-clears.description: Named clears originate inside retiring image/text layer callbacks. Independent target readers verify visible, hidden-owner and hidden-effect results; a final same-batch deletion leaves queued clears as the only target owners before submission.

effect-clear-setup.description: Automatic image/text FBO setup clears: empty and complete strings reset colors, nonstring values do not, same-size effect count changes repeat setup while ordinary updates preserve seeded contents. No named function is called.

effect-clear-history.description: Partial clear strings retain parsed prefixes without setup reset; named clears and discarded shader writes preserve image/text history across hidden effects and owner deletion.

effect-named-clears.description: Named effect clear functions with exact names, nonleading and duplicate FBO references, filtered declarations, RGBA consumers, hidden calls, text relayout and recreation. Complete-string setup transitions and deletion after queued clears are explicit.

effect-material-bulk.description: Bulk effect property writes retain scalar/Vec2 admission while Vec3/Vec4 inputs, ordinary Vec4 constructors and direct four-component material writes drive independent image/text shader bands through relayout, hiding and recreation. Six finite Vec4 dot products additionally drive the existing image/text scalar materials.

effect-material-selection.description: Material record count and named/indexed lookup with command gaps, last duplicate/empty selection and rejected input conversion drive three independent image/text shader regions.

effect-material-name.description: Live effect names, nullish writes, string-hint conversion, exceptions, NUL/Unicode transport and scripted names drive current image/text material consumers through hidden owners and recreation.

layer-effect-selection.description: Image and text layer effect-method membership, full count, exact named/indexed selection and rejected argument types; shader-consumed tags and paired tint/visibility controls expose every result.

layer-effect-selection-lifecycle.description: Select effects on freshly created image and text owners across hiding, text relayout, whole-owner deletion and recreation; independent effect scripts drive the paired material/target controls.

named-target-parent-retirement.description: Nested composition first/last-child callbacks reselect current card-sized destinations through repeated deletion batches, while a hidden shared peer and surviving parent retain their identities.

named-target-dependency-retirement.description: A dependency reader retains its private target after the source owner is deleted; effect-backed text relayout keeps a hidden equal-text peer, then the final batch removes all remaining target consumers.

named-target-retirement.description: Repeat live destination extent selection and whole-owner deletion while a hidden peer retains shared square targets; unique effect targets and source images retire with their last owner.

owner-destroy-callback-batches.description: Repeat callback-created replacements and remove both remaining image owners together; final material, script, timer and imported-image references must retire before the next cycle.

owner-destroy-callback.description: Deferred owner destruction invokes layer and refreshed material callbacks while a surviving scripted image and a hidden shared model retain their resources.

material-pass-shape.description: Shape material overrides preserve recursively merged constants and the owner-selected DIRECTDRAW program.

material-pass-scene-reflection.description: Material overrides are consumed by the scene reflection pass and displayed through a raw reflection target reader.
